functions.name: CAST

parameters.description: Value to cast and target type

functions.description: Converts a value from one data type to another
examples: SELECT CAST(price AS VARCHAR) FROM products

functions.name: TRY_CAST
functions.returnType: Target type specified in cast, nullable

parameters.description: Value to cast and target type

functions.description: Attempts to convert a value, returns NULL on failure
examples: SELECT TRY_CAST('abc' AS INTEGER) -- Returns NULL

functions.name: TO_CHAR

parameters.description: Value to convert, optional format string

functions.description: Converts a value to a character string

functions.name: TO_VARCHAR

parameters.description: Value to convert, optional format string

functions.description: Converts a value to a varchar string

functions.name: TO_NUMBER

parameters.description: String to convert, format pattern

functions.description: Converts a string to a number using a format

functions.name: TRY_TO_NUMBER

parameters.description: String to convert, format pattern

functions.description: Attempts to convert string to number, returns NULL on failure

functions.name: TO_BOOLEAN

parameters.description: Value to convert to boolean

functions.description: Converts a value to boolean

functions.name: TO_DATE

parameters.description: Value to convert, optional format string

functions.description: Converts a string or timestamp to a date

functions.name: TO_TIMESTAMP

parameters.description: Value to convert, optional format string

functions.description: Converts a value to a timestamp

functions.name: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP

parameters.description: Value to convert, optional format string

functions.description: Attempts to convert to timestamp, returns NULL on failure

functions.name: TYPEOF

parameters.description: Value to get type of

functions.description: Returns the data type of an expression as a string

functions.name: COALESCE

parameters.description: Values to check for non-null

functions.description: Returns the first non-null value in a list

functions.name: NVL

parameters.description: Value to check and replacement if null

functions.description: Returns the second value if the first is null

functions.name: IFNULL

parameters.description: Value to check and replacement if null

functions.description: Returns the second value if the first is null

functions.name: NVL2
functions.returnType: Least restrictive type of 2nd and 3rd args

parameters.description: Value to check, value if not null, value if null

functions.description: Returns second arg if first is not null, else third arg

functions.name: NULLIF
functions.returnType: Same as first argument, force nullable

parameters.description: Two values to compare

functions.description: Returns NULL if two values are equal, else returns first value

functions.name: NULLIFZERO

parameters.description: Numeric value to check

functions.description: Returns NULL if the value is zero

functions.name: CASE
functions.returnType: Least restrictive type of result expressions

parameters.description: CASE expression with WHEN/THEN pairs

functions.description: Conditional expression that returns different values based on conditions
examples: SELECT CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN 'A' WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END
SELECT CASE status WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'inactive' THEN 0 END

functions.name: IF
functions.returnType: Least restrictive type of result expressions

parameters.description: Condition, value if true, value if false

functions.description: Returns one of two values based on a condition
examples: SELECT IF(quantity > 0, 'In Stock', 'Out of Stock') FROM products

functions.name: IFF

parameters.description: Condition, value if true, value if false

functions.description: Inline IF function (Snowflake compatible)
